simple.summary: גְּשׁוּר (Gᵉshûwr) means Geshur , a district of Syria First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 23.

definitions.full: H1650. Geshur גְּשׁוּר proper name, masculine ( bridge ? or land of bridges ? compare Wetzst Hauran, 82 ). 1 of people, = הַגְּשׁוּרִי Josh 13:13 compare 1Chr 2:23 . 2 of land גְּשׁוּר מֶלֶךְ 2Sam 3:3 ; 13:37 compare 13:38 (but text in disorder compare ᵐ5 We Dr) 14:32 ; 15:8 ׳בִּגְ בַּאֲרָם 1Chr 3:2 , גְּשׁ֫וּרָה 2Sam 14:23 ; a territory east of the upper Jordan, exact limits unknown; according to Guthe ZPV xii. 1889, 232 f. between Gilead and Hermon, in Jaulân ; according to Furrer ib. xiii. 1890, 198 = the Ledjah , district east of Jaulân, with town Jisre ; against him Guthe ib. 285 f .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to join); bridge;
